cv.name: Aoife Twomey
cv.headline: Business Analyst | Requirements, process mapping & reporting
cv.summary: Business analyst with three years of experience in insurance and shared-services teams, returning after a two-year career break for family care. Comfortable running workshops, writing user stories and turning messy process knowledge into clear documentation for developers and the business.

Run weekly backlog refinement with the product owner and a team of six developers

Write acceptance criteria and support UAT with claims handlers

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst
bullets: Produced weekly operational reports in Power BI for the finance shared-services centre
Captured requirements for an invoice-matching automation that cut manual touches by roughly 30%
Supported a SAP Concur rollout to 900 employees with process guides and training sessions

experience.title: Operations Assistant

Power BI, Excel (Power Query), basic SQL
